name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
headline: Graphify turns codebases into queryable knowledge graphs
lede: You can query a codebase, docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs as a graph built by local deterministic AST parsing, with no vector store.

effects.effect: Works as a skill across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.

appearances.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
appearances.summary: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
